description: NaVO₃ crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/c space group. There are two inequivalent Na¹⁺ sites. In the first Na¹⁺ site, Na¹⁺ is bonded to six O²⁻ atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent VO₄ tetrahedra and edges with five NaO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.30-2.37 Å. In the second Na¹⁺ site, Na¹⁺ is bonded to six O²⁻ atoms to form distorted NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent VO₄ tetrahedra, edges with three equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent VO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.60 Å. V⁵⁺ is bonded to four O²⁻ atoms to form VO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with five NaO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent VO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 34-69°. There are a spread of V-O bond distances ranging from 1.65-1.81 Å. There are three inequivalent O²⁻ sites. In the first O²⁻ site, O²⁻ is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na¹⁺ and two equivalent V⁵⁺ atoms. In the second O²⁻ site, O²⁻ is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to two Na¹⁺ and one V⁵⁺ atom. In the third O²⁻ site, O²⁻ is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to three Na¹⁺ and one V⁵⁺ atom.
